dod_intent_evidence: Genuine and extensive DoD motion (AF Phase II SBIR $1.7M 2023, $37.5M Space Force contract 2024, $54.5M Space Force APFIT contract Feb 2026, PWSA Deorbit-as-a-Service contract Jan 2026) — but this is exactly why it's dropped: the APFIT (Accelerate Procurement and Fielding of Innovative Technologies) award and the operational PWSA deorbit-service contract show the company has already crossed from prototype into fielded procurement, not stuck in the valley of death.
what_they_do: Builds the Otter autonomous satellite-servicing vehicle for life extension and disposal; already holds a $54.5M Space Force APFIT procurement contract and an operational PWSA deorbit-as-a-service contract — crossed the valley of death.
